sections.heading: Period and recognized source actuals
sections.text: USD; Q2 2026; period ended 2026-06-30. Revenue $13,685,000; COGS $5,200,300; opex $11,370,050; operating result $-2,885,350. Recognize engineering and development revenue against accepted contracted work; do not recognize projected asteroid sales.

sections.heading: Income reconciliation
sections.text:
Does recognized revenue cover delivery and operating costs?

Operating result remains negative after both delivery costs and development spending; the reconciliation isolates the reported loss rather than presenting revenue as profit.

sections.heading: Margins and spending intensity
sections.text:
How much revenue remains after delivery costs, and how much is consumed by operating spending?

Gross margin and operating margin answer different questions. A positive delivery margin does not imply that the development program is self-financing.

sections.heading: Service revenue mix
sections.text:
Which contracted activities produce recognized revenue?

Engineering services, instrument development, and mission analysis sum to recognized revenue. No asteroid commodity-sales category is introduced.

sections.heading: Operating cost allocation
sections.text:
Where is development capacity being funded?

Research and development, program operations, and corporate administration reconcile to operating expenses. The allocation makes the development priority visible without treating costs as capitalized assets.

sections.heading: Workforce and delivery productivity
sections.text:
What output is supported by the period-end workforce snapshot?

Revenue and completed work packages per period-end employee are descriptive operating ratios, not labor-efficiency guarantees. Headcount is a point-in-time measure and is not summed across quarters.

sections.heading: Available-period trends and commitments
sections.text:
How do available quarter results and contracted commitments relate?

Quarter trends use only known periods. Backlog is a remaining-work snapshot, not cash or recognized revenue; rejected runs remain visible alongside accepted evidence.
